name: @pipeworx/mcp-shodan

tools.name: shodan_host
tools.description: What's exposed on IP <ip> — open ports, services, and CVEs. Returns the full Shodan host profile: ports, hostnames, org/ISP, geolocation, OS, known vulnerabilities, and a per-service banner sample. Example: shodan_host({ ip: "8.8.8.8", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ip.description: IPv4 address to look up, e.g. "8.8.8.8"

_apiKey.description: Shodan API key (account.shodan.io; paid membership required)

tools.name: shodan_host_search
tools.description: Search Shodan for hosts matching <query> using Shodan search syntax (e.g. "apache country:US", "port:22 org:\"Google\""). Returns matching hosts with IP, port, org, hostnames, product, and location. Example: shodan_host_search({ query: "apache country:US", _apiKey: "your-key" })

query.description: Shodan search query. Supports filters like country:, org:, port:, product:, os:, e.g. "apache country:US"

_apiKey.description: Shodan API key (account.shodan.io; paid membership required)

tools.name: shodan_host_count
tools.description: Count hosts matching <query> with facet breakdown (free — this endpoint does not consume query credits). Returns the total match count plus optional facet aggregations (e.g. top countries, orgs, ports). Example: shodan_host_count({ query: "apache", facets: "country:10", _apiKey: "your-key" })

query.description: Shodan search query, e.g. "apache" or "port:443 country:DE"

facets.description: Comma-separated facets for aggregation, e.g. "country:10" or "org:5,port:5" (optional)

_apiKey.description: Shodan API key (account.shodan.io; paid membership required)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-shodan forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the shodan pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
